notes.text: The Campaign Begins. Welcome to Abelon
The party met at The Star and Raven where they spoke with a Vaelseer before being offered a job
The job was to escort a prisoner. However, upon learning what the prisoner had done, the party sided with him, freed him and returned to the inn
Heading to Tallowhaven, the party were accosted by another party. They overpowered their opponents with ease
Following the fight, the party spoke with a courtesan accompanying their foes who gave them a ring that looked similar to the interior of a nearby wellspring
Once in Tallowhaven, the party split to further different goals. One group heading to  Honeywell to meet Oskar who offered a job, the other to Alderman's Hall to meet Huw who agreed to meet tomorrow
Waking up at The Amber Cup, the party met Huw who shared with Wren some mysterious Isolde artefacts
The party went to clear a warehouse for Oskar. On arrival, they again sided against their employer and refused the task. They returned to Oskar to explain themselves
They then went to meet Otho, Huw's mentor, to learn more about the artefacts. The party also learned  more about Dohyuk's journey through Tallowhaven
Wren was given a Zarethi artefact to investigate and learned that Dohyuk got the Aeronic ring from Otho
Party asks Otho for more information on the artefacts' provenance and told to return in 2 days
Party meets with Seva and Mira Sable and agrees to retrieve a lost necklace
Party retrieves Seva's lost necklace from Edvin Crost
Party meets with Alric and agrees to take the debt collector job after all. The job is completed.
The party agreed with Alric to remove the blockade and find information to help Alric track who is ultimately responsible for it
Party learns from Otho that the Aeronic ring and Zarethi box both came from the Everbloom Shrine, East of Tallowhaven
Party ambushed by 6 humans while leaving Tallowhaven to remove blockade. Overcomes their attackers after a challenging fight
Party encounters Marek arguing with local bard about Aeron's apparent failures and the failures or his workshippers. Arjay argues for personal accountability and Marek backs down
As the party reaches the end of the day, they're ambushed by very unhealthy wolves. The party make short work of them.
The party heads to the barricade, meets the people blocking the path and swiftly kills all but one of them
The party questions the remaining barricader, learning that Dohyuk was beaten up there and sent back to Tallowhaven, and that there is a 'real' barricade further along the path
They arrive at the 'real' barricade and discover it is managed by Halloway Logistics
Wren uses his family connection to negotiate the removal or the camp and reinstatement of the bridge
After celebrating with the Halloway crew, the party wakes to find both camps eerily silent and Arjay missing
Arjay is found stabbed to death near the bridge, his blood black and congealed like the diseased wolves they'd fought
Searching the scene, the party recovers Arjay's Aeronite ring and finds a Broken Wing symbol scored into the ground, with an arrow pointing east
The party cremates Arjay and follows the eastward sign for an hour before the trail goes cold, forcing them to turn back
That night, three diseased bears stumble on their camp; the party abandons their tent and flees rather than fight
Pushing through the night without rest, the exhausted party makes it back to Tallowhaven. Wren becomes convinced the camp's silence the night Arjay died was no natural thing
In Cooper's Square, the party finds Mira distraught: a fellow Sable, Elbeth, has been taken, with a note pointing towards Emlyn Hale of the Driftwood delegation
Mira introduces Danzel, a Sable courtesan, who agrees to help investigate Elbeth's disappearance
Mira recognises the ring on Wren's hand as Dohyuk's, and recalls he seemed defeated and said he was heading east when he left it with her
The party reports the cleared blockade to Alric Venn and collects the outstanding 450 gold
Tracking Emlyn Hale to a seedy inn, the party forces a confession: he and a fixer called Oak Strong staged Elbeth's kidnapping to extort Seva Sable
Interrogating Oak Strong, the party learns his hired muscle panicked and actually took Elbeth, holding her at Coppergate Stables
The party storms Coppergate Stables and rescues Elbeth after a hard-fought battle, killing two of her captors and capturing a third
The party loots the stables, keeps the crew's two horses, and brings Elbeth and the surrendered Sot back to the Amber Cup
Seva and Mira welcome Elbeth home; grateful for her rescue, Mira gifts Danzel Mirelda's Coin, a token of the Hearthkeepers' Accord granting the bearer free lodging across Abelon
Danzel persuades Mira to hand over the long-withheld second page of Dohyuk's letter, which suggests he has deliberately avoided writing home so his brothers won't come running
Rather than set off for Crossroads immediately, the party decides to first detour to the Everbloom Shrine, hoping to understand the ring and box Otho gave them
At the Amber Cup, Mora tells the party the Broken Wing has no hideout and no club, just an idea some people attach themselves to
In Cooper's Square, Danzel joins the performer Pen to lift the crowd. The party buys a second-hand cart, finds the horses' saddles at the stables and names the horses Vernon and Mingyu
Leaving Tallowhaven, the party reaches the Everbloom Shrine and finds it visibly dying — the ground, air and plant life all touched by an unnatural stillness

At the shrine, an elf named Costin Marrow reveals himself as a follower of the Broken Wing and explains its real philosophy: that one must replace what is taken, and that many who invoke it for violence are not true believers

Costin tells the party the shrine's real power has always lain in the catacombs beneath it, and that Otho has a ledger once kept by past shrinekeepers. Bring it back, he says, and the power they seek may be theirs
Uneasy about aiding anything connected to the Broken Wing, but curious what it might reveal, the party agrees to retrieve the ledger from Otho and heads back toward Tallowhaven
Returning to Tallowhaven, the party finds the Threadbare Spine, Otho's magic shop, destroyed by an explosion
Searching the wreckage, the party finds blood and ransacked cabinets, and traces Otho's young assistant Huw to Sorastra's Rest, Tallowhaven's infirmary

Huw admits he had taken the Shrinekeepers' Ledger himself and hidden it when Otho came looking; Otho attacked him and the shop came down. Huw hands the ledger, Isolde's pigments and the rod to the party, and Otho is nowhere to be found
A further search of the ruins turns up intact potions and spell scrolls, but no further trace of Otho
Studying the ledger, the party finds no record of their ring or box, many torn-out pages, numbers written around the shrine's sigil, and a donor, Garo Marro, who may be kin to Costin
With the trail gone cold, the party resolves to stop chasing the ledger and set out for Crossroads in the morning
At the Amber Cup, Tenok meets Foss, editor of the Trumpet, who tells him of the Tradesmasters scandal and offers to run a notice about Dohyuk
Over breakfast, Seva and Alric Venn separately ask the party to meet them at seven that evening, at the Amber Cup and the Shallow Tuber
Testing the ring and box at the dried Wellspring again finds no trace of Aeron, yet the faintest trace of Zareth, which has no reason to be there
